title: Airy Aromatic Syrian Hake Skewers
description: A sweet and crumbly Syrian dish featuring hake, served on a bamboo tray, perfect for a brunch mood. This paleo-friendly recipe is made with a mother-sauce-base and is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Add the hake cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated hake cubes onto bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the hake is cooking, prepare the mother-sauce-base by mixing together 1/4 cup of olive oil, 2 tablespoons of lemon juice, and 1 teaspoon of sumac.
Once the hake is cooked, brush the mother-sauce-base onto the skewers.
Serve the hake skewers on a bamboo tray, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
